how_value_is_shown: The mat and foam pieces are on screen from the first second. The voiceover says the products give the little ones room to develop and play, and the parents get quiet (about 8-13 s) while the footage shows the baby on the mat and the toddler playing alone beside her. At about 22-26 s she says she no longer has to split her time because she can play with both together.

personal_story: A mother with a 2-year-old and a 2-month-old: her biggest fear was how to divide her time between them, and the play corner solved it ('מאז שקיבלתי את המשלוח').
